ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Webshell Creation On Static Website
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of files with certain extensions on a static web site. This can be indicative of potential uploads of a web shell.

sequences.query: ((file_path = RGX(".*\\\\inetpub\\\\wwwroot\\\\.*") AND (file_path = RGX(".*\\\.ashx.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.asp.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.ph.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.soap.*"))) OR ((file_path = RGX(".*\\\\www\\\\.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\\htdocs\\\\.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\\html\\\\.*")) AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\.ph.*"))) AND  NOT ((file_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*")) OR process_path = "System" OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\\xampp.*"))
